question: How should dual-brain handle budget and usage tracking?
claude_position: No absolute usage tracking — there's no API to query real subscription quotas. Relative session awareness (you've used Claude a lot this session) is the most we can honestly claim.
gpt_position: Agree. Without actual provider usage APIs, internal counters are fiction. Local estimates are only useful if clearly labeled as estimates, not driving hard routing decisions.
synthesis: No fake usage tracking. No sparkline bars. No percentage-of-quota displays. Work style drives routing, not budget math. Session-level provider lean is the only honest metric. API guardrail for metered keys.
